# catan.gg

> A free web tool that draws a random Settlers of Catan board. It covers the
> classic 19-hex map for 3 and 4 players and the 30-hex expansion for 5 and 6
> players. It runs in the browser, needs no account and needs no install.

## What the tool does

- Places the resource hexes and the number tokens one at a time, and steps
  back whenever a position runs out of pieces. That is why it can satisfy a
  rule that a plain shuffle almost never reaches.
- Applies four setup rules, each a checkbox: keep 6 and 8 apart, keep 2 and 12
  apart, keep matching numbers apart, keep matching resources apart. The first
  and the third are on by default.
- Prints the pip count under every number token.
- Shows the pip total per resource and a balance score from 0 to 100.

## Facts a reader may want

- The classic map uses 19 hexes: 4 lumber, 4 grain, 4 wool, 3 brick, 3 ore and 1 desert.
- The classic map uses 18 number tokens: 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6, 8, 8, 9, 9, 10, 10, 11, 11, 12.
- The expansion map uses 30 hexes, 28 number tokens and 2 deserts.
- The classic map has 42 shared edges between hexes. The expansion map has 71.
- Two dice give 36 combinations. A pip counts one of those combinations.
- Pips per number: 2 and 12 have 1, 3 and 11 have 2, 4 and 10 have 3, 5 and 9 have 4, 6 and 8 have 5.
- The 7 has 6 combinations, the most of any total, and no hex carries it.
- The classic map has 24 inland corners. Each inland corner touches three hexes.
- A corner is worth the sum of the pips of the three hexes around it, up to 15.
- Keeping 6 and 8 apart is the rule the printed manual states. The other three
  rules are house rules.

## Pages

- [Catan board generator](https://catan.gg/): the tool, plus how it works, the
  number odds, the setup rules and the common questions.
- [Catan dice odds](https://catan.gg/catan-dice-odds): every number token, its
  pip count, its ways to roll and its chance, plus the full two-dice grid.
- [Catan setup rules](https://catan.gg/catan-setup-rules): the printed rule,
  the three house rules, and what each one changes about the board.
- [The 5-6 player expansion](https://catan.gg/catan-5-6-player-expansion): the
  30-hex board, the piece counts and how the layout differs.

## Notes

- catan.gg is an independent fan tool. It is not affiliated with the publisher
  of CATAN, and CATAN is a trademark of its owner.
